page.overview:
Who is Shukar?

Rear Admiral Shukar was a male Andorian Starfleet flag officer in the mid-23rd century. ()

Following the near-defeat of the United Federation of Planets in the , Shukar was among Admiral Katrina Cornwell's retinue. When the returned from the mirror universe, Shukar, together with , boarded the ship and secured the bridge before Cornwell and Ambassador Sarek transported aboard. ()

Shukar was later consulted via holographic communication by Cornwell after she, Sarek, and Emperor devised a plan to end the war by striking the Klingon home planet, Qo'noS directly. ()

After the cessation of hostilities, Shukar was present in Paris on Earth when the crew of the Discovery was honored for their role in ending the war. ()
